leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Starmie Surprise is the third monthly issue of the Pokémon Adventures manga to be released by VIZ Media. It contains chapters seven, eight, and nine of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
